subsystem.name: VehiclePhysicsSystem
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle lifecycle subsystem: loads .veh vehicle files and the 104-slot session vehicle grid, writes per-vehicle .scn scene templates, builds the vehicle graphics scene graph, renders 2D vehicle labels, maintains the global physics-object node pool, gates session input dispatch, and tears down collision/handle resources at shutdown. Adjacent audio-engine and engine-block initialization routines are grouped here only because the packet groups them; no common ownership is proven.

summary: Vehicle_physics packet covers the vehicle data path (loadVehicleFiles 0x004C3D80, LoadVehicleEntries 0x004B70B0, writeVehicleSceneFileTemplate 0x004DDF90, VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader 0x004DFCE0), the presentation path (VehicleLabel2DRenderer 0x0049F870, VehicleFlagCheck 0x0049BB20), the session/input gate (InputDispatchAndSessionSync 0x00463CD0), teardown (CollisionSystemShutdownCleanup 0x00494900, UnlinkAndFreePhysicsNode 0x0053CE40), and two adjacent initializers (EngineInitBlock 0x0053C2C0, AudioEngine initialize 0x00546010, PhysicsSubsystemInitDispatcher 0x0056D410). The vehicle array is a shared, count-header-prefixed allocation (dword_8AC394, 1060-byte entries) consumed by loader, grid loader, scene template writer and scene graph loader. Ownership of most objects is UNKNOWN or GUESS; class boundaries here are conservative proposals, not proven source structure.

function_roles.role: Per-call session gate: dispatches queued input commands to entities and synchronizes session state when the state-guard DWORD at obj+0x3FC4 is non-zero, then unconditionally clears the dispatch flag byte at obj+0x374; returns the guard value on the zero path or the object pointer on the sync path.

Collision-resource shutdown cleanup over six adjacent global handle slots (0x7CDE04..0x7CDE2C): ResourceCascadeCleanup plus zeroing for the three cascade slots, destructor/free-wrapper cleanup for the four destructor slot pairs; returns the last accumulated cleanup result.
Pure query of a byte flag at offset 0x4108 (16648) of the vehicle object behind global dword_7C54E0; returns whether the flag is non-zero. Used by HUD flag renderers as a vehicle flag gate.

Gather-and-draw 2D overlay labels for visible vehicles: gated by byte_7CE254, sorts a distance-gathered vehicle list with MergeSort, and renders up to three text labels (name, position, timing gap) via scissored 2D text rendering; frees the gather list after the pass.

Vehicle-grid loader: peeks the queue head, loops the 104 vehicle slots (18624-byte stride) resolving each entry, transitions session state to 3 on a found entry (delegate, string copy, driver-name set) or -1 on a missing entry, then stores the loaded count, rebuilds the active-vehicle pointer array, clears load-state globals, parses scene data, initializes AI, and returns MultiplayerVehiclePlacement.

Bulk loader of .veh vehicle files from the season directory into the global count-header-prefixed vehicle array (1060-byte entries at dword_8AC394); tears down any prior array, enumerates and parses each file into a slot, logs 'Failed reading %s' on format failure, then delegates to VehicleDataLoader and returns the loaded count.

Writes a per-vehicle .scn scene template: streams a source template line by line substituting directive tags (id, vehdir, teamdir, spin/notspin, high/med/low, dashhigh/dashlow), with detail selection from a per-vehicle detail mode or a backup override file; logs errors unless the console-mode flag equals 5.

Loads and initializes the vehicle graphics scene graph for one vehicle slot: reads and optionally post-processes the scene file, resolves the root node by 'SLOT%03d', resolves wheels/spindles/wings/debris/cockpit/arms/light nodes, assigns audio and disc-glow references, copies the source bounding box, pulls vehicle data and sound-effect handles from global tables, and collects tire child nodes into a per-tire array; returns the collected tire count.

Engine-state block initializer: zeroes the whole block, explicitly clears the first, second and eleventh dword fields, runs an init sub-routine with argument 1, writes three global engine/audio constants, flushes MMX state, and returns the block pointer. Unconditional; no guards.

Shared physics-object node teardown: removes a node from the global doubly-linked list (head dword_8B8F14, prev/next at node+0x12C/+0x130), runs teardown stubs, frees the node, and decrements the physics-object count at dword_8B6AC0; returns 0 on both the not-found and success paths.

Audio-engine initialization: probes the driver, allocates and registers a 496-byte mixer channel into *a1 with flags ORed at +0xEC, allocates sample and vertex-buffer resources, accumulates sample sizes under +0x110, walks the audio-node list running the per-node init pipeline, and returns 0 on success or -1 after unlinking on any allocation failure.

Physics-subsystem init dispatcher: delegates initialization to sub_56E970(this), then frees the quad-pointer block at this+0x34 and returns that free operation's result; called from PhysicsInitSequence.

classes.name: SessionSyncController
classes.responsibility: Gates session-wide input dispatch and state synchronization on a per-call state guard; owns the dispatch flag cleared each call.

classes.name: CollisionResourceCleanup
classes.responsibility: Shutdown teardown of collision-resource global handle slots: cascade cleanup plus destructor/free-wrapper cleanup for two distinct slot families.

classes.name: VehicleStatusQuery
classes.responsibility: Read-only gate on a vehicle flag used by HUD flag rendering; reads the flag through the global vehicle pointer dword_7C54E0.

classes.name: VehicleLabelRenderer
classes.responsibility: Gathers visible vehicles, sorts them by distance, and renders up to three scissored 2D text labels per vehicle; manages the per-frame label time budget.

classes.name: SessionVehicleGridLoader
classes.responsibility: Loads the session vehicle grid: resolves the 104 vehicle slots against a queue, transitions session state per slot, rebuilds the active-vehicle pointer array, parses scene data, and initializes AI.

classes.name: VehicleFileLoader
classes.responsibility: Bulk-reloads .veh vehicle files from the season directory into the global count-header-prefixed vehicle array and delegates parsed data to the vehicle data loader.

classes.name: VehicleSceneFileModule
classes.responsibility: Generates per-vehicle .scn scene files from a source template by substituting directive tags with per-vehicle runtime values and gating detail sections by a selected detail level.

classes.name: VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader
classes.responsibility: Reads a vehicle scene file, resolves the named scene-graph nodes (wheels, spindles, wings, debris, cockpit, arms, lights), assigns audio and disc-glow references, copies bounding boxes and vehicle data, and collects tire child nodes into a per-tire array.

classes.name: EngineBlockInitializer
classes.responsibility: Zero-initializes an engine-state block, clears selected fields, runs an init sub-routine, and writes global engine/audio constants.

classes.name: PhysicsNodePool
classes.responsibility: Shared doubly-linked pool of physics-object nodes with a tracked global count; removal patches both links, updates the head, runs teardown stubs, and frees the node.

classes.name: AudioEngine
classes.responsibility: Audio-engine initialization: probes the audio driver, creates and registers a mixer channel, allocates sample and vertex-buffer resources, accumulates sample sizes, and runs the per-node audio-node init pipeline.

classes.name: PhysicsSubsystemInitializer
classes.responsibility: Dispatcher for physics-subsystem initialization: delegates to an init routine then frees the quad-pointer block at offset 0x34.

transitions.trigger: guard zero path skips dispatch and sync
slot lookup finds nothing; session state set to -1
slot lookup finds an entry; session state set to 3, driver name assigned

interfaces.name: SessionInputDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Dispatch queued input commands to session entities and then synchronize session state; gated by the session-state guard.

interfaces.name: VehicleFileParsing
interfaces.purpose: Parse .veh vehicle records and scene data into the global vehicle array.

interfaces.name: ResourceTeardown
interfaces.purpose: Cascade cleanup and free of pooled handles and physics nodes, with conditional free-flag handling.

interfaces.name: SceneNodeResolver
interfaces.purpose: Resolve named scene-graph children under a root node into object handles used by the vehicle graphics scene loader.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleArrayCountHeaderLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The global vehicle array (dword_8AC394) is a payload pointer 4 bytes after a count-header block; entries are 1060 bytes (265 dwords), the count lives in the header and is mirrored in dword_8AC390. A replacement loader must preserve this header-plus-payload allocation scheme and the per-entry stride.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsNodeDoublyLinkedPool
compatibility_contracts.description: Physics-object nodes live in a global doubly-linked list (head dword_8B8F14, prev/next at node+0x12C/+0x130) with a tracked count at dword_8B6AC0. Removal patches both links, updates the head, runs teardown stubs, frees the node, and decrements the count.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSceneFileDirectives
compatibility_contracts.description: The .scn template writer substitutes the directive tags id, vehdir, teamdir, spin, notspin, med/high/low and dashlow/dashhigh with per-vehicle values; non-matching detail levels emit the placeholder marker. A replacement generator must reproduce these directives and the detail-level gate (v29/v30).

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSceneInstanceNaming
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle graphics scenes are instanced by 'SLOT%03d' name derived from the parent slot index obj+0x4894, and child nodes are resolved by fixed names (wheels, spindles, wings, DEBRIS%d, catsteer, tire names rftire/lrtire/rrtire, sound names tread/treadmed/treadlow). A replacement scene loader must honor these names.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionStateGuardSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Session dispatch is gated by a state guard DWORD at obj+0x3FC4; a non-zero guard runs input dispatch then session sync and returns the object pointer, a zero guard returns the guard value; either path clears the flag byte at obj+0x374.

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioEngineInitReturnContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Audio-engine initialization writes a 496-byte mixer channel into *a1, appends it to the mixer list, ORs flag bits into its +0xEC flags, allocates sample and vertex buffers, accumulates sample sizes under the +0x110 block, walks the audio-node list, and returns 0 on success or -1 (after unlinking) on allocation failure.

unresolved: Most function owner objects are UNKNOWN: the object types behind dword_7C54E0 (VehicleStatusQuery), the SessionSyncController object, and the EngineBlockInitializer block are not established.
dword_8AFE64 is flagged as read by packet facts for 0x00494900, 0x0049F870 and 0x004DFCE0 but is absent from every raw decompiled body; its role is unverifiable here.

Ten read-only float globals (flt_59E440, flt_59E444, flt_59E448, flt_59E478, flt_59E874, flt_59E970, flt_59F0C0, flt_59F124, flt_5A68E8, dbl_5ACB18) are flagged for 0x0049F870 and never appear in the rendered source.
Four read-only globals (flt_59E43C, flt_59E854, flt_59ED18, flt_5AD14C) are flagged for 0x004DFCE0 and never appear in the rendered source.

unresolved packet globals for the vehicle grid loader and scene module: unk_5EC6D0, dword_7D2E48, unk_8AC368 (0x004B70B0) and global 0x005C67E0 (0x004DDF90); none are consumed by any evidenced operation.
unresolved packet globals for the audio and engine blocks: unk_8B6BD0 (0x0053C2C0) and global 0x008B8F24 (0x00546010).

The vehicle record layout behind dword_8AC394 entries (1060-byte stride) is only partially evidenced: the .veh record bytes at v4+65, v4+97, v4+1 (LoadVehicleEntries) and record fields +0/+32 (writeVehicleSceneFileTemplate) are not named fields in the packet.
The wheel-setup loop writes float data at byte offsets inside the wheel blocks that are not represented in the packet field table; only 0x1EC is listed, so those write sites are under-evidenced.
The arms-child collection stores matched child handles at dword indices 558..559, conflated with the comparison-result region 0x8C4 in the operation evidence.
The distinction between ResourceCascadeCleanup slots and DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear slots in CollisionSystemShutdownCleanup is structural, not semantic.
QuadPointerFree is named in the raw source of 0x0056D410 but is absent from the packet callee list, so its address cannot be recorded here.
The per-character vehicle-record offset mapping for unknown .scn tokens (v14[k] + v32 - 9) has unclear semantics.
The AudioEngine owner type is DERIVED from a legacy ABI name and audio subsystem tag, not CONFIRMED; the callback dword_8B8F00 and constants 16/0 are unevidenced.

Equal field offsets observed on different function objects (e.g. this+0x4 in EngineBlockInitializer and VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader) are NOT merged into a common class because the packet does not prove common ownership.
